card.name: Chaos, fractals and feedback-loop language
card.fires_on: Words in non-medical science text about chaos, fractals, recursive patterns or feedback, such as "coupled", "Fibonacci", "Mandelbrot" and "runaway". It fires just before a word like cycle, loop or sequence could follow.

modes.label: Chaos and fractal terms
modes.description: Words naming coupled chaotic systems, fractals or number sequences.
modes.example: a scheme to generate chaotic binary codes by using a chain of<< coupled>> chaotic maps

modes.label: Linking words in chain descriptions
modes.description: Small words like "of" or "a" inside phrases describing a chain or series of steps.
modes.example: once it gets close to the ground<< a>> positively charged streamer rises to meet it

modes.label: Runaway feedback
modes.description: Words describing self-reinforcing change in climate or physical processes.
modes.example: It’s not quite a<< runaway>> situation, but it does accelerate once

card.writes: It lowers the odds of cycle and loop words coming next, so it likely steers away from repeating-cycle wording.
card.plain: It lights up in science passages about chaos, fractals and runaway feedback, just before a word like cycle might appear.
